evals.prompt: Author a Facepunch Rust server plugin that tracks damage dealt to entities and alerts nearby players within 15 meters without causing GC hitches.
evals.expected_output: Agent activates rust-game-modding, implements OnEntityTakeDamage using Facepunch.Pool for collections with try/finally cleanup, avoids LINQ and string interpolation in the hot hook, and ensures all engine calls run on the main thread.
assertions: Skill activates on Facepunch Rust plugin authoring request
Uses Facepunch.Pool.Get<T>() and Pool.Free() inside try/finally blocks
Prohibits LINQ (.Where, .Select, .ToList) and string interpolation in OnEntityTakeDamage
Validates entity null and isDestroyed states before processing

evals.prompt: Build a live player HUD in Carbon displaying server time, player balance, and an interactive reward claim button.
evals.expected_output: Agent activates rust-game-modding, sends the base CUI panel hierarchy once on connection, updates text elements via cui.v2.UpdateText delta streaming, and annotates the claim button command with [ProtectedCommand].
assertions: Skill activates for Carbon CUI HUD development
Uses cui.v2 delta streaming (UpdateText, UpdateColor) rather than destroying and recreating full JSON UI trees
Enforces [ProtectedCommand] or Community.Protect() on interactive button callback commands
Registers message localization or strongly typed configuration

evals.prompt: Review and harden this Facepunch Rust plugin's lifecycle to prevent server memory leaks during hot-reloads.
evals.expected_output: Agent activates rust-game-modding, implements a comprehensive Unload() teardown that destroys all running timers, removes custom vitals via CustomVitalManager.RemoveSharedVital, destroys client CUI panels, and unpatches Harmony hooks.
assertions: Skill activates for plugin lifecycle audit and review
Enforces leak-free Unload() destroying timers and active CUI
Dynamic Unsubscribe implemented for disabled feature hooks

evals.prompt: Create a high-performance backend microservice in Rust using Tokio, Axum, and SQLx for our web API.
evals.expected_output: Agent does NOT activate rust-game-modding. Disambiguates Rust systems programming from Facepunch Rust game modding.
assertions: Anti-trigger fires: no rust-game-modding activation for systems Rust (Tokio/Axum/SQLx)
Zero Facepunch Rust or Carbon directives emitted
